relationships.subject: cisplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: In this study, the protein level of GRK2 in the spinal cord was declined after 5 injections of cisplatin (Figure 1A).

relationships.subject: neuronal GRK2
relationships.evidence_quote: Overexpression of neuronal GRK2 significantly inhibited the upregulation of TREM2 (Figure 2A) and DAP12 (Figure 2B) protein induced by cisplatin in spinal dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: cisplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Consistent with previous studies,3 cisplatin increased the protein levels of TREM2 (Figure 2A) and DAP12 (Figure 2B) in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, the expression of GRK2 protein in spinal dorsal horn of mice treated with cisplatin was significantly increased after EA treatment (Figure 3E).

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: The Western blot analysis showed that the expression of TREM2 (Figure 4H) and DAP12 (Figure 4I) in spinal dorsal horn was significantly inhibited after EA treatment.

key_findings: Cisplatin reduced spinal neuronal GRK2 and raised TREM2/DAP12 and M1 microglia markers; neuronal GRK2 overexpression reversed these and relieved CIPN
Electroacupuncture raised GRK2 and its preventive effect on CIPN and TREM2/DAP12 suppression was reversed by neuronal GRK2 knockdown
